questions.prompt: When someone calls after 4:30pm or on a weekend with an emergency, what should happen — reach the on-call plumber right away, or take details and have them called back?
questions.why: Callers with a burst pipe want to know if anyone is coming tonight.

options.label: Connect or text the on-call plumber immediately
Take details, on-call plumber calls back
Book for next business day unless it's flooding

questions.prompt: Is there a separate after-hours or emergency call-out charge, and if so how much?
questions.why: It's usually the first question on a night call.
